# Support

Need help? Two ways:

1. **Family members**: the site itself is the guide — start at the [Tutorial Library](https://lxh113377.github.io/filialconnect/pages/tutorials.html), every tutorial uses large print and numbered steps.
2. **Everyone else**: open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/lxh113377/filialconnect/issues) — content corrections, translation improvements and accessibility defects are all welcome. Use the content-proposal template for new tutorials.

This is a small, single-maintainer open-source project; we aim to respond within a week.
